verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers that connect applications to BigQuery with the user's preferred tooling, which covers the standard-driver half of the story. For BI-tool integrations the only support is a hands-on community test of the BigQuery-Sheets connector, which worked with a minor caveat: formulas came back as Text cells. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of integrations with named BI/dashboard tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and independent hands-on corroboration that the JDBC/ODBC drivers connect dashboards without custom glue.

support.subject: As an analyst, standard drivers (JDBC/ODBC) and documented BI-tool integrations connect my dashboards without custom glue

citations.quote: The Simba Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers for BigQuery connect your applications to BigQuery, letting you use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling and infrastructure.
Tested the BigQuery-Sheets connector for their org: 'there's a lot of promise.'
